name: Private Dinner & Dialogue
headline: Save the date in Fresno.
summary: Sundae's private dinner for Fresno-area real estate operators, hosted by Josh Stech on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. Time and venue are to be announced, so everything here is a save the date for now: it names the city and the date, never a time, a venue or a seat claim.
strategy: Two phases. Save the date now: Josh's announcement, the marketplace list, personal notes to the 50 most active Central Valley buyers and a small lead-form ad budget that builds the interest list. Then, once the time, venue and RSVP link are confirmed, a two-week invitation sprint with the qualifying RSVP and a show-rate system.
creativeNote: Designed in Sundae's brand from real photos only: Josh Stech's photos from sundae.com, the Sacramento dinner photo (captioned as Sacramento) and openly licensed photos of Fresno itself (the Old Fresno Water Tower and the downtown skyline, credited on every asset; they show the city, not the venue). No AI footage. QR codes go to the Sundae Membership intro call until an RSVP link exists. Videos and Reels are silent by design: add trending audio in-app for organic posts and a licensed track for ads.
sources: The date, city, host and audience are from the agency (Oct. 20-21, 2026). Josh's bio and the dinner series' talking points are from sundae.com and Sundae's Manhattan Beach dinner materials. Budgets and projections are the Manhattan Beach base case, labeled assumptions. City photos: Mel B. (CC BY 2.0) and DoulosBen (CC BY 4.0).
